rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Per-exercise leap test — 3 observable Monday outcomes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L118-121 (maintainer block) name three falsifiable outcomes: 'Writes a failing test that proves the bug exists before touching the fix' (falsifiable via commit history — test commit before/with the fix, reflecting the bug); 'Pushes back on at least one line in a diff' (falsifiable via scrollback/commit body showing a line-level objection); 'Runs root-cause interrogation before accepting Claude's first fix' (falsifiable via a scrollback turn before any commit). Named verbs on the engineer's own codebase, not abstract competencies — each is independently checkable Monday morning without reference to this file.

Maintainer 'Watch-fors' (L102-104) names two dominant failure modes each with a named trainer recovery: 'Tests-skipped' (student jumps straight to a fix) → 'back up — what's the failing test that would prove this bug exists?'; 'Diff rubber-stamp' (student says 'looks fine' under 30 seconds) → 'find me one line you'd have written differently — not wrong, just different.' Both of the file's forcing functions (test-first, diff push-back) carry a named failure mode and a named recovery move; the interrogation beat's failure mode is covered by the same rubber-stamp pattern one level deeper.
